basic_profile.bio: I'm a culinary adventurer new to the Tampa area, always on the lookout for the best local eats. Originally from the Midwest, I've recently moved for a job opportunity in digital marketing. I spend my weekends exploring food joints and sharing my finds online. My work allows me flexible hours, so you might find me online during the late mornings or early afternoons. Currently single, I enjoy the freedom to travel and taste new cuisines.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Gained knowledge through personal experiences in food tasting and travel. I also possess a marketing degree, which helps in understanding consumer trends. I frequently attend food festivals and workshops to enhance my culinary insights.
